text:
dana: Quick logistics check for Sam's remote start on Mon — two things: welcome crate delivery (laptop + badge) and I-9 verification. Can we lock courier pickup and an I-9 rep slot? @tom can you handle staging at the SF office if crate arrives early?

 tom: Yep. Need shipping address and preferred delivery window. I can reserve lobby pickup and badge staging.

 dana: Ship to: Sam Rivera, 412 Oak Ave, Apt 2B, San Francisco, CA 94102. Please mark SIGNATURE_REQUIRED. Target delivery by 12pm Mon. If vendor asks, label as "Redwood welcome kit" (no sensitive info).

 tom: Reserved courier slot 09:00-11:00 for pickup, staging at Main Lobby. Creating temp badge entry: SAM-481.

 badge-bot: Badge request created for Sam Rivera — ID SAM-481. Pickup code 7390. Staged at Main Lobby. ETA: Mon 11:30.

 maya: FYI vendor flagged Sam's background check as "manual review" (submitted Fri). I messaged vendor support; they quoted 48-72 hrs. We should plan a fallback if not cleared by Monday.

 jorge: For I-9 options: Sam is remote — either (A) Sam visits SF office for in-person verification, (B) use an authorized agent near Sam, or (C) we send an in-person rep (costly). Which does Sam prefer? We have an I-9 rep available Mon 10:30-12:00.

 sam: I can come into SF office on Mon. 11:00 works. Please block 30 mins for I-9 and escort.

 jorge: Blocked 11:00-11:30 with I-9 rep (Jorge). Escort added. Bring passport + SSN card OR passport + original ID.

 maya: If BG hasn't cleared by then, we do provisional access: escorted laptop pickup + limited VPN until clearance. Need IT to create a time-limited VPN profile.

 tom: Created temp VPN user onboarding-sam, expires in 7 days. Access: limited to corporate onboarding apps only. I'll submit policy to security for review.

 courier-bot: Courier label created. Tracking: TRK12345678. Pickup scheduled Mon 09:30. Signature required.

 sam: Thanks all. One ask — can the crate include a small welcome note + basic onboarding quickstart print? Helps new folks.

 (dana reacts :thumbsup: to sam)

  dANA: Yes — adding a quickstart leaflet. Manifest below for courier and security: 

```
manifest:
- laptop: MacBook Pro 14" (serial redacted)
- charger
- badge: SAM-481
- welcome leaflet: 1
- privacy form: 1 (to mail back)
```

 maya: I'll keep monitoring BG vendor; will update in this thread if status changes. If not cleared by Mon 9am, we'll escalate to vendor ops and set up escorted-only access.

 tom: All set from IT/courier side. I'll DM Sam the pickup code and building directions.

 dana: Perfect. Final checklist for Monday: courier tracking sent, badge staged, I-9 11:00 with Jorge, temp VPN created, BG monitor in place. Thanks everyone — re-open thread if anything slips. :party_popper:
